kandidaty.zagolovok: datasette-llm 0.1a11
kandidaty.tekst:
Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11

datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins.

This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol.

This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0) you can run Datasette via uvx like this:

wget https://datasette.io/content.db

uvx --with datasette-agent datasette \
--root --secret 1 \
-s plugins.datasette-llm.default_model '{
"model": "lmstudio-qwen",
"model_name": "qwen/qwen3.8-27b",
"api_base": "http://localhost:1234/v1"
}' content.db

And you'll get a local server running a Datasette Agent instance powered by your local model!

Tags: uv, datasette-agent, llm, datasette, llms, ai, generative-ai

@btibor91: OpenAI and Anthropic this week: Fable 5.2, IPO roadshow, ChatGPT Wallet, Daybreak Red Team, Claude Meetings (Week 46, 2026)

OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, which lets dots complete purchases with your approval, rolling out gradually to Pro subscribers in the US

Businesses in ChatGPT arrived in beta, with Business Hub for claiming a business and Business Agents for eligible US businesses

ChatGPT dots can now connect to multiple local computers, follow custom instructions and reply faster

OpenAI will retire Advanced and Standard voice on December 11, since virtually all voice users are already on GPT-Live

OpenAI built Control Room to track and stop model workloads across its research infrastructure, halting model output within 35 seconds of a decision

OpenAI appears to be testing a new ChatGPT web interface with dedicated cards, and I believe this one is called Nova

Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, the same underlying model, with Mythos limited to verified organizations

A thousand Fable 5.2 agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in 28.7 hours

Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO of 825 million Class A shares at an expected 70 to 78 dollars per share, and applied to list on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT

Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets started rolling out in beta on paid plans, and Claude Data, formerly Dashboards, is now generally available there

Claude Meetings started rolling out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, where Claude joins a Google Meet call as a visible participant

Anthropic launched self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta, so the harness, sandboxes and session history run in your own cloud or on-premises, and more
